definitions.explanation: Having an atmosphere of gravity, reverence, and dignity. Used to describe ceremonies, buildings, music, and other things that inspire awe and respect.

examples.japanese: {厳|おごそ}かな{雰囲気|ふんいき}だった。
{式|しき}は{厳|おごそ}かに{執|と}り{行|おこな}われた。
{神社|じんじゃ}の{鳥居|とりい}をくぐると、{厳|おごそ}かな{空気|くうき}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: Passing through the shrine's torii gate, I was enveloped in a solemn atmosphere.

notes:
Often associated with religious sites, traditional ceremonies, and formal occasions. The adverbial form {厳|おごそ}かに is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厳|おごそ}かな{雰囲気|ふんいき} — solemn atmosphere
・{厳|おごそ}かに{執|と}り{行|おこな}う — to conduct solemnly
・{厳|おごそ}かな{儀式|ぎしき} — solemn ceremony
・{厳|おごそ}かな{音楽|おんがく} — majestic music

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{荘厳|そうごん} — sublime, august (more literary)
・{神聖|しんせい} — sacred, holy (religious nuance)
・{厳粛|げんしゅく} — solemn, grave (more formal, less sensory)
